title: Bosun PKM Typed Relations Contract v1
description: Validates a `$pkm.relations` block inside note YAML frontmatter — not an entire markdown file. Canonical nesting matches existing yeoman/commonplace fixtures: `$pkm: { relations: { <verb>: <urn> | [<urn>, ...] } }`. This object form uses typed predicate verbs with canonical URN targets `urn:<realm>:<entity_type>:<uuid>` (UUID portion `[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}`). It is distinct from the older array-of-`{target,type}` edges used by `$yeoman:interaction/v1` and `canonical-note-contract-v0.1.json`. Unknown verbs are rejected. Each verb accepts a single matching URN string or a non-empty array of matching URNs (one-or-more; harbormaster docs are explicit that interactions may link one or more contacts, and the verb-keyed contract was otherwise ambiguous).
